QuestInfo.name: Maple Science Weekly
QuestInfo.0: The scientific journal Maple Science Weekly has announced a new technology that drives monsters away with the awesome power of sound! Maple Administrator is looking for Maplers to help collect noise to drive the monsters out. #bClick on the #i3994375#Event Notifier#k on the left side of the screen to find out more.
QuestInfo.1: Maple Administrator gave you a Noise Recorder. Record various noises for 30 minutes to help research a device to drive away monsters. When you're done, #bclick on the #i3994375#Event Notifier#k on the left side of the screen to talk to the Maple Administrator.
QuestInfo.2: You returned the Noise Recorder and received a reward.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #b4 times a day #i4310027:# #t4310027:# x 1 Upon completion, obtain a #i2022827#Resort Relaxation buff#k

Would you mind holding onto this #bNoise Recorder for 30 minutes#k and recording the background noise of your adventures for me?
